A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XIV · the restless family

Undead

Seven monster girls who should not be walking: the living doll, the will-o'-wisp, the yuki-onna, the phantom, the vampire, the zombie and Frankenstein's monster. Spooky rather than evil: most of them stalk you because they are lonely.

Favourite food: Pumpkin pie (the zombie wants rotten flesh)

The central similarity

They follow you home.

Every undead girl fixes on a person. The doll and the yuki-onna creep after you when you are not looking, the vampire visits at night, the phantom comes for those who do not sleep. Win them over and the stalking turns into company.

  • StalkingSeveral only move while you are not looking at them.
  • NightMost are night walkers; sunlight weakens the vampire and the zombie.
  • LonelyThey warm up fast once fed: pumpkin pie is the family food.
  • Never cruelThe vampire drinks a little blood but never kills; the zombie bites, then can be befriended with rotten flesh.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a undead builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Pumpkin pie (+2)
  • Rotten flesh for the zombie
  • Sleeping well (the phantom leaves the rested alone)
  • Letting the vampire drink (+3)

What costs trust

  • Hitting her
  • Shining a light on the doll while she moves

Devoted (60+)

She haunts your enemies instead: hostile mobs near you get Weakness, and she brings eerie presents (soul sand, bones, an echo shard).

Mating & young

FormA single daughter. YoungA daughter, grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her mother. Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed (the vampire invites herself).
2. ExpectingA day later her daughter arrives (the doll's daughter is a smaller doll, found sitting beside her).
3. HauntingThe young haunt their mother's favourite places.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to her father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

CreepingThe living doll, the yuki-onna and the jack o'lantern's cousins move only while you look away. Turn around and they freeze.
InsomniaThe phantom girl appears above players who have not slept for three nights, like a vanilla phantom, and swoops.
Night visitsA vampire may appear by your bed while you sleep: you wake a little weaker (two hearts and Weakness), never killed. A polite one asks first (right-click to say yes).
Rotten fleshThe zombie attacks at first; rotten flesh calms her, more builds friendship.
LightThe will-o'-wisp glows (a real light), floats and sets fire to whatever attacks her.
Cold touchThe yuki-onna's touch freezes (like powder snow).

Living Doll (about 0.95 blocks)

TemperamentClingy, jealous, very sweet once loved

Ecology & behaviourA porcelain doll who wants a home. She follows a player she has chosen, moving only when she is not watched.

Signature: Moves when unseenShe creeps after her chosen player only while not being looked at, and freezes when watched. Reaching you, she tugs at your sleeve (a small push) until fed.

Player interactionTurn around and let her catch up; give her pie.

Will-o'-wisp (about 1.4 blocks)

TemperamentPlayful, flighty, a little dangerous

Ecology & behaviourA girl of cold flame who floats over marshes and leads travellers astray. Her lower body is a tail of fire.

Signature: Fire and lightShe floats, glows (a real light) and is fireproof; whatever hits her catches fire. At night she leads the player she likes towards buried treasure or a shipwreck.

Yuki-onna (about 1.8 blocks)

TemperamentCold, lonely, quietly affectionate

Ecology & behaviourThe snow woman. She drifts through blizzards in a white kimono and follows travellers, unseen.

Banshee (about 1.75 blocks)

TemperamentMournful, gentle, protective

Ecology & behaviourThe bean sí, the woman of the fairy mound in Irish folklore. Her keening warns of a coming death. Here it is a warning you can act on, not a curse. She combs her long hair with a silver comb.

Signature: KeeningWhen a player within 24 blocks drops to three hearts or fewer, she keens. Every hostile mob within 16 blocks of that player glows for ten seconds, as a bell shows raiders. She keens at most once a minute for each player.

Player interactionPumpkin pie, and listen when she cries.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Gashadokuro: befriended, she seizes a monster near her friend and lifts it into the air
  • Ghoul: befriended, she eats the rotten flesh near her friend and it heals her
  • Kasurenijimi: befriended, her friend sneaking near her blurs out of sight. Draugr: befriended, the undead hunting her friend give up
  • Doll and yuki-onna creep after you only while unseen; the doll only tugs
  • Yuki-onna: freezing touch, only in snowy biomes (melts elsewhere)
  • Phantom girl: flies, spawns above players who have not slept for three nights, keeps vanilla phantoms away once calm
  • Vampire: bedside visits (one night in five), polite ones ask first, never below one heart; sluggish in sunlight
  • Zombie: hostile until fed rotten flesh
  • Will-o'-wisp: floats, glows, burns attackers, guides to treasure at night
  • Frankenstein's monster: very shy, lightning heals and strengthens her, a bodyguard when devoted
  • Devoted: Weakness on monsters near you
  • Yurei: floats; at night, befriended, the monsters near her friend grow weak (Weakness I)
  • Mummy: blows loosen her bandages, a crouching pull unravels her a layer at a time down to skimpy wraps, then she spins back up; she guards tomb chests from strangers

Not yet

  • A shelf block for the doll

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The phantom has no biome spawns: she comes for the sleepless.
  • Vampires never kill: they stop at one heart.

Open questions

  • Should the doll be able to sit on shelves (a block)?
